answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 28161 Country: India Title: Is salam jayaz during wuzu,azan,eating?Sunnat of sitting in the Baitul Khala. Question: As salamo Alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.Is salam jayaz during wuzu,azan,eating?Sunnat of sitting in the Baitul Khala. Answer ID: 28161 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 39/39/M=1432) It is makrooh to do salam to a person who is making wudhu and is busy in reciting the dua of wudhu. Likewise, salam is makrooh at the time of azan and to a person who is busy eating. Places where one should not do salam is mentioned in Shami and other Fatawa books. One should sit in toilet in a way that one's face or back is not towards the Qiblah; rather it should be towards north or south. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
